name: betalike
expr: [nL_basic, av] = betalike([2, 2], x); nL_x_oor = betalike([2, 2], [0.5 1.5]'); nL_a0 = betalike([0, 2], x);
comment: Sig: [nL, AVAR] = betalike([a b], x). NLL for Beta(a, b). AVAR is the 2×2 inverse of the BHHH (outer-product-of-gradients) Fisher info — MATLAB's betalike uses BHHH, not the Hessian (verified by direct probe). Edge: invalid params or x outside (0,1) => NaN.
